senses.gloss: नाट्य- + आचार्य नाट्य- + आचार्य, m. a dancing master, Mṛcch. 49, 2.

नट् नट् (a form of नर्त्, vb. नृत्), i. 1, Par.
 1. To dance, Gīt. 4, 9.
 2. To injure.
 --Caus. and i. 10,
 1. To dance, to represent as an actor, to act, Śāk. 6, 11.
 2. † To fall.
 3. † To speak or shine.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. नाटित, n. Representing, Śāk. 43, 4, v. r.

नट नट (a form of नर्त),
 1. m. A mime, MBh. 1, 6940.
 2. f. टी, An actress, Śāk. 3, 9.
 3. m. A tree, Caloranthes indica, Jonesia asoca, Rām. 5, 74, 4.
 --Comp.
नटता नट + ता, f. The state of an actor, Hariv. 8692.
नटन नट् + अन, n. Dancing, Pañc. iii. d. 237.

नाटक नाटक, i. e. नट् + अक,
 I. m. A mime, Rām. 1, 5, 18.
 II. n. A drama, Rām. 2, 69, 4.
नाटितक नाटित + क (vb. नट्), n. A gesture, Śāk. 73, 4.

नाट्य नाट्य, i. e. नट + य, n.
 1. The art of acting or dancing, scenic art, Bhāg. P. 4, 15, 19.
 2. Mimical representation, Mṛcch. 88, 4.
 3. The attire of an actor, Bhāg. P. 1, 8, 19.
